map.屈光不正(球柱轴)交叉柱镜计算器 使用指南: Refractive Error (Spherocylinder Axis) Cross Cylinder Calculator User Guide
map.支持正负柱镜转换、等效球镜与功率向量分解，以及两片柱镜(过矫/叠加)联合计算。: Supports positive and negative cylinder conversion, equivalent sphere, power vector decomposition, and the combined calculation of two cylinders (over-correction / stacking).
map.等效球镜 SE = S + C/2；功率向量 M = S + C/2，J0 =: Equivalent sphere SE = S + C/2; power vector M = S + C/2, J0 = −(C/2)·cos2α, J45 = −(C/2)·sin2α; transposition: S′ = S + C, C′ = −C, α′ = α + 90°
map.等效球镜与功率向量把处方分解为球性(M)与两个散光分量(J0/J45)，用于正负: The equivalent sphere and the power vector decompose a prescription into a spherical part (M) and two astigmatism components (J0/J45), used for positive and negative cylinder transposition, two-cylinder stacking (over-correction) and axis normalisation.
map.球柱镜转功率矢量：M = S + C/2、J0 = −(C/2)cos2ax、J: Spherocylinder to power vector: M = S + C/2, J0 = −(C/2)cos2ax, J45 = −(C/2)sin2ax.
map.正/负柱镜互转、两处方矢量相加。: Positive and negative cylinder conversion, and vector addition of two prescriptions.
map.顺规/逆规/斜轴散光判定。: With-the-rule, against-the-rule and oblique astigmatism determination.
map.：M = −3.5；J0 = −(−0.5)cos360 = −0.5；J45: M = −3.5; J0 = −(−0.5)cos360 = −0.5; J45 = 0; SE = −3.5; against-the-rule (ATR, axis near 180°). Transposing the negative cylinder gives S=−4.0, C=+1.0@90.
map.：将两副眼镜各自功率矢量相加再还原，得到等效联合处方，便于比较。: Add the power vectors of the two prescriptions and convert back to get the equivalent combined prescription, which is easier to compare.
map.泪膜破裂时间(BUT)标准评估器: Tear Film Break-Up Time (BUT) Standard Evaluator
map.21 题自适应视力筛查（单眼度数估算）- 在线工具: 21-item Adaptive Refraction Vision Screening (single-eye diopter estimate) - Online Tool
map.功率矢量把散光表示为正交分量，便于统计与加法，避免轴位 180° 跳变问题。: The power vector represents astigmatism as orthogonal components, which makes statistics and addition easy and avoids the axis 180° wrap-around problem.
map.等效球镜 SE = S + C/2，衡量整体屈光不正程度，用于筛查与统计。: The equivalent sphere SE = S + C/2 measures the overall degree of refractive error and is used for screening and statistics.
